answer_1.quote: This research addresses this gap by analyzing the performance of VLMs in answering questions related to choropleth maps...
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to visual questions about choropleth maps, including binary responses, single words, lists, counts, ranges, and rankings.

answer_2.quote: For binary yes/no and integer count answers, we implemented an exact match criterion and accuracy as the evaluation metric...

answer_3.quote: To address this, we used an 'LLM as an Extractor' approach, using Gemini 1.5 Flash to extract answers from their outputs.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation of the MapWise dataset to establish a human baseline and benchmark model performance against human evaluators.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation encompassed 450 questions, comprising 150 unique questions uniformly sampled from each of three countries... we maintained an equal distribution across answer types and map categories.
